fields.name: target_anchor
fields.description: A [y, x] point identifying the demonstrated cube at the start of execution. Identify the cube actually grasped in the demonstration, then follow its identity through the release and all subsequent demonstration movements, including exchanges with other cubes. Use its visible center in the initial execution scene, not its original grasp location. Keep this anchor unchanged throughout execution; small subsequent placement shifts do not change which cube it identifies. Initial anchors are [93, 140] in episode 2, [122, 119] in episode 4, [92, 156] in episode 62, [112, 116] in episode 83, and [112, 158] in episode 85. e.g. [122, 119]

fields.name: completed_cycles
fields.description: The number of completed execution pick-up-and-put-down cycles as of this decision step, excluding the demonstration. Initialize to 0. Increase by one at the decision step following a completed put-down command, never when merely selecting that command. Internal releases or retries during a pick-up command do not count. Values across steps are [0, 0, 1, 1, 2] for episodes 2, 83, and 85, and [0, 0, 1] for episodes 4 and 62. e.g. 1
